summary: Account o.polat@aegean.edu exhibits confirmed suspicious access signals with no verified abuse chain. F1 shows impossible travel from Amsterdam to Manisa in 180 minutes {T1078.004}. F2 records 20 sign-ins from DigitalOcean AS14061 (NL) outside baseline {T1078.004}. F3 records 9 sign-ins from Hetzner AS24940 (DE) outside baseline {T1078.004}. Risk Gate verdict is escalate at confidence 0.63; evidence supports access signals but not a confirmed abuse chain, so containment is not yet warranted.

No rejected claims or data-quality conflicts. Evidence supports immediate containment rather than monitor/benign/escalate.
